new_value: Verified fixed in commit 95d85c3747: Args::node_id is Option<String> (no fixed default), resolve_node_id(None, id.iid) derives advertised node ID from generated/persisted identity, explicit IDs still validated against identity IID. Unit test implicit_node_id_tracks_generated_identity_but_explicit_id_is_validated passes (9/9 lichend bin tests). Smoke run: default --sim --no-tun starts with derived IID and no abort; explicit mismatched --node-id aborts with 'configured root IID does not match persisted identity' (exit 1). No code changes required.
